claims.text: A standard elemental Cr coating on zirconium-alloy cladding is prone to Cr-Zr interdiffusion and premature failure at high temperature.
The proposed intervention is an approximately 50 nm CrN interlayer between the zirconium-alloy substrate and elemental Cr coating.
The CrN interlayer can be deposited by reactive sputtering after plasma cleaning of the zirconium-alloy surface.
The applicable simulated PWR-water exposure is approximately 320 degrees Celsius and 11.3 MPa for up to 60 days.
The applicable accident-relevant exposure is steam at approximately 900 degrees Celsius for several hours.
Reactive sputtering and plasma cleaning will produce a uniform, dense CrN interlayer.
The CrN interlayer will bond tightly to both zirconium alloy and the overlying elemental Cr coating.
CrN is refractory and chemically inert under the proposed exposure conditions.
CrN has reduced cation mobility that allows it to act as a diffusion barrier.
The CrN barrier will impede elemental transport between the zirconium substrate and the Cr coating.
Suppressing elemental transport will prevent premature interfacial degradation.
Suppressing interfacial degradation will preserve the oxidation resistance of the elemental Cr layer during high-temperature exposure.
Relative to unmodified Cr-coated cladding, the CrN-containing coating will exhibit significantly less Cr-Zr interdiffusion.
Relative to unmodified Cr-coated cladding, the CrN-containing coating will have improved oxidation resistance in both PWR water and high-temperature steam.
Relative to unmodified Cr-coated cladding, the CrN-containing coating will retain better mechanical integrity after prolonged exposure.
TEM and EDS can be used to quantify Cr-Zr interdiffusion profiles.
SEM and XRD measurements can assess oxide-scale thickness, phase, and integrity.
Three-point bending and scratch testing can compare coating integrity and adhesion before and after exposure.
Long-term adhesion and mechanical stability of the ultrathin CrN layer under cyclic thermal and mechanical stress remain uncertain.
